description: A small square rainbow pop-it toy sits on the tabletop in front of both hands. The left hand comes in from the left edge to steady the pop-it while the right hand approaches from the right; they briefly hold it as a two-hand object to adjust its position, then both hands press down on the silicone bubbles row by row, with the right hand doing most of the popping and the left hand anchoring and occasionally pressing nearby bubbles as the toy stays centered on the desk.
